## Overview

This document deepens the integrated analysis from Parts 1–2. We add:
comprehensive data discovery (sub-pathway distributions, volcano plots,
metabolite ID mapping via MetaboAnalyst API), a detailed sphingolipid pathway
dissection (ceramide chain-length, SM species, gene panel), lysosomal
dysfunction analysis (cathepsins, XIAP axis), pre-ranked GSEA with fgsea,
and cross-omics concordance scoring.

## Enhanced Data Discovery

### Super-Pathway Distributions

Metabolon assigns each metabolite to a super-pathway (broad class) and
sub-pathway (specific category). We compare class composition and significance
rates across timepoints.

```{r}
#| label: fig-super-pathway-dist
#| echo: true
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 6

# Combine metabolomics from both timepoints
met_combined <- bind_rows(
  met_9m |> dplyr::select(biochemical, super_pathway, sub_pathway,
                          log2fc, p_value, significant) |>
    mutate(timepoint = "9 Months"),
  met_15m |> dplyr::select(biochemical, super_pathway, sub_pathway,
                           log2fc, p_value, significant) |>
    mutate(timepoint = "15 Months")
)

# Count metabolites and significance rate per super-pathway
sp_summary <- met_combined |>
  group_by(timepoint, super_pathway) |>
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_sig = sum(significant),
    pct_sig = n_sig / n_total * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(super_pathway = fct_reorder(super_pathway, n_total, .fun = max))

sp_cols <- unname(glasbey(n_distinct(sp_summary$super_pathway)))

# Panel A: Total metabolites per super-pathway
p_sp_count <- ggplot(sp_summary,
       aes(y = super_pathway, x = n_total, fill = super_pathway)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_total), hjust = -0.1, size = POST_LABEL_SIZE) +
  facet_wrap(~ timepoint) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sp_cols, guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Metabolite Counts by Super-Pathway",
       x = "Number of metabolites", y = NULL) +
  theme_post() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Panel B: Significance rate per super-pathway
p_sp_sig <- ggplot(sp_summary,
       aes(y = super_pathway, x = pct_sig, fill = super_pathway)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%%", pct_sig)), hjust = -0.1, size = POST_LABEL_SIZE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ timepoint) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sp_cols, guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Significance Rate by Super-Pathway (p < 0.05)",
       x = "% significant", y = NULL) +
  theme_post() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

p_super_pathway <- p_sp_count / p_sp_sig +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Metabolite Class Distribution: Rps2-A226Y Mutant vs WT",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16))
  )

p_super_pathway
```

### Volcano Plots {.tabset}

Standard volcano visualizations of all four datasets. Labels highlight the most
significant features. Metabolomics significance: p < 0.05; Transcriptomics: FDR < 0.05.

```{r}
#| label: volcano-function
#| echo: true

# Reusable volcano plot (uses pre-computed 'significant' column)
plot_volcano <- function(df, fc_col, pval_col, label_col,
                         title_label, sig_line_p = 0.05) {
  plot_df <- df |>
    mutate(
      .fc = .data[[fc_col]],
      .neg_log10p = -log10(pmax(.data[[pval_col]], 1e-10)),
      .label = .data[[label_col]],
      .direction = case_when(
        significant & .fc > 0 ~ "Up",
        significant & .fc < 0 ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    )

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = .fc, y = .neg_log10p, color = .direction)) +
    geom_point(aes(alpha = .direction, size = .direction)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(sig_line_p),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = \(d) d |> filter(.direction != "NS") |>
        slice_max(.neg_log10p, n = 12),
      aes(label = .label), size = POST_LABEL_SIZE, max.overlaps = 12,
      segment.color = "grey60", show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(Up = "#d95f02", Down = "#1b9e77",
                                  NS = "#cccccc"), name = NULL) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(Up = 0.8, Down = 0.8, NS = 0.15),
                       guide = "none") +
    scale_size_manual(values = c(Up = 1.8, Down = 1.8, NS = 0.5),
                      guide = "none") +
    labs(title = title_label,
         x = expression(log[2] ~ "Fold Change"),
         y = expression(-log[10] ~ "(p-value)")) +
    theme_post() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Data Quality & Metabolite ID Mapping

The 9-month metabolomics file includes KEGG, HMDB, and PubChem identifiers;
the 15-month file does not. We use the MetaboAnalyst compound mapping API to
retrieve standardized IDs for the 15-month metabolites.

```{r}
#| label: metabolite-overlap
#| echo: true

# How many metabolites are shared between timepoints?
shared <- intersect(met_9m$biochemical, met_15m$biochemical)
only_9m <- setdiff(met_9m$biochemical, met_15m$biochemical)
only_15m <- setdiff(met_15m$biochemical, met_9m$biochemical)

tibble(
  Category = c("Shared", "9m only", "15m only"),
  Count = c(length(shared), length(only_9m), length(only_15m))
) |> knitr::kable(caption = "Metabolite overlap between timepoints")
```

```{r}
#| label: metaboanalyst-id-mapping
#| echo: true

# Map 15m metabolite names to standardised IDs via MetaboAnalyst REST API
# Strip trailing asterisks (Metabolon confidence markers) before querying
# Replace semicolons in names (API uses ; as delimiter)
met_names_clean <- met_15m$biochemical |>
  str_remove_all("\\*$") |>
  str_replace_all(";", ",") |>
  str_trim()

body <- list(
  queryList = paste(met_names_clean, collapse = ";"),
  inputType = "name"
)

api_result <- request("https://rest.xialab.ca/api/mapcompounds") |>
  req_body_json(body) |>
  req_timeout(120) |>
  req_perform() |>
  resp_body_json()

# Convert API response to tidy data frame
met_id_map <- tibble(
  biochemical = met_15m$biochemical,
  query_clean = met_names_clean,
  match       = api_result$Match,
  hmdb        = api_result$HMDB,
  kegg        = api_result$KEGG,
  pubchem     = api_result$PubChem
) |>
  mutate(mapped = hmdb != "" & !is.na(hmdb))

cat("MetaboAnalyst mapping:", sum(met_id_map$mapped), "/",
    nrow(met_id_map), "metabolites mapped to HMDB IDs\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-fc-distribution
#| echo: true
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5

# Fold-change distribution comparison
fc_combined <- bind_rows(
  met_9m  |> transmute(log2fc, layer = "Metabolomics",    timepoint = "9m"),
  met_15m |> transmute(log2fc, layer = "Metabolomics",    timepoint = "15m"),
  tx_9m   |> transmute(log2fc, layer = "Transcriptomics", timepoint = "9m"),
  tx_15m  |> transmute(log2fc, layer = "Transcriptomics", timepoint = "15m")
)

p_fc_distribution <- ggplot(fc_combined, aes(x = log2fc, fill = timepoint)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  facet_wrap(~ layer, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("9m" = "#66a61e", "15m" = "#7570b3"),
                    name = "Timepoint") +
  labs(title = "Fold-Change Distributions",
       subtitle = "Rps2-A226Y Mutant vs WT, Liver",
       x = expression(log[2] ~ "Fold Change"), y = "Density") +
  theme_post() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
p_fc_distribution
```

## Sphingolipid Deep Dive

The manuscript identifies sphingolipid metabolism as the central adaptive
response to ribosomal mistranslation. Here we dissect: (1) ceramide acyl
chain-length specificity linked to Cers2/Cers4, (2) sphingomyelin species
accumulation, and (3) a comprehensive gene panel for the pathway.

### Ceramide Acyl Chain-Length Analysis

Ceramide synthases Cers2 (downregulated) and Cers4 (upregulated) synthesise
ceramides with C22–C27 and C18–C22 acyl chains respectively. We extract chain
lengths from metabolite names to check whether this specificity is visible in
the metabolome.

```{r}
#| label: fig-ceramide-chain-length
#| echo: true
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 7

# Filter sphingolipid metabolites and extract acyl chain lengths
sl_subpathways <- c("Sphingomyelins", "Ceramides", "Lactosylceramides (LCER)")

sl_met <- bind_rows(
  met_9m  |> filter(sub_pathway %in% sl_subpathways) |> mutate(timepoint = "9 Months"),
  met_15m |> filter(sub_pathway %in% sl_subpathways) |> mutate(timepoint = "15 Months")
)

# Parse the N-acyl chain carbon count from metabolite names
# Pattern: d18:1/22:0 → second chain = 22
sl_met <- sl_met |>
  mutate(
    acyl_carbon = as.integer(str_extract(biochemical, "(?<=/)\\d+(?=:)"))
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(acyl_carbon))

cat("Sphingolipid metabolites with parsed chain lengths:", nrow(sl_met), "\n")

# Cers2/Cers4 substrate ranges for annotation
cers_ranges <- tibble(
  enzyme = c("Cers4 (C18–C22, up)", "Cers2 (C22–C27, down)"),
  xmin = c(18, 22), xmax = c(22, 27),
  ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf
)

p_ceramide_chain <- ggplot(sl_met, aes(x = acyl_carbon, y = log2fc,
                   color = sub_pathway, shape = significant)) +
  geom_rect(data = cers_ranges, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax,
                fill = enzyme),
            alpha = 0.08) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_jitter(size = 2.5, width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ timepoint) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Cers4 (C18–C22, up)" = "#d95f02",
                               "Cers2 (C22–C27, down)" = "#1b9e77"),
                    name = "CerS substrate range") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Sphingomyelins" = "#7570b3",
                                "Ceramides" = "#e7298a",
                                "Lactosylceramides (LCER)" = "#66a61e"),
                     name = "Sub-pathway") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 1), name = "p < 0.05") +
  labs(title = "Sphingolipid Metabolites by Acyl Chain Length",
       subtitle = "Shaded regions = ceramide synthase substrate specificity",
       x = "N-Acyl Chain Carbon Count",
       y = expression(log[2] ~ "FC (Mutant / WT)")) +
  theme_post() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1), color = guide_legend(nrow = 1))
p_ceramide_chain
```

### Sphingomyelin Species Accumulation

```{r}
#| label: fig-sm-species
#| echo: true
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

# All SM species across timepoints
sm_data <- bind_rows(
  met_9m  |> filter(sub_pathway == "Sphingomyelins") |>
    dplyr::select(biochemical, log2fc, p_value, significant) |>
    mutate(timepoint = "9m"),
  met_15m |> filter(sub_pathway == "Sphingomyelins") |>
    dplyr::select(biochemical, log2fc, p_value, significant) |>
    mutate(timepoint = "15m")
)

# Shorten names for plotting
sm_data <- sm_data |>
  mutate(label = str_replace(biochemical, "sphingomyelin", "SM") |>
           str_remove("\\*$") |> str_trim())

# Order by 15m fold change
sm_order <- sm_data |>
  filter(timepoint == "15m") |>
  arrange(log2fc) |>
  pull(label)
sm_data <- sm_data |> mutate(label = factor(label, levels = sm_order))

p_sm_species <- ggplot(sm_data, aes(x = log2fc, y = label, color = timepoint,
                    shape = significant)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("9m" = "#66a61e", "15m" = "#7570b3"),
                     name = "Timepoint") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 1), name = "p < 0.05") +
  labs(title = "Sphingomyelin Species: Fold Change (Mutant / WT)",
       x = expression(log[2] ~ "Fold Change"), y = NULL) +
  theme_post() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11))
p_sm_species
```

### Sphingolipid Pathway Gene Panel

Complete gene panel for sphingolipid biosynthesis (de novo arm), ceramide
metabolism (salvage pathway), SM conversion, and the S1P signalling axis.

```{r}
#| label: fig-sl-gene-panel
#| echo: true
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 9

# Full sphingolipid gene panel with pathway arm annotations
sl_genes <- tribble(
  ~gene_name, ~arm,
  "Sptlc1", "De novo synthesis", "Sptlc2", "De novo synthesis",
  "Kdsr",   "De novo synthesis",
  "Cers1",  "De novo synthesis", "Cers2", "De novo synthesis",
  "Cers3",  "De novo synthesis", "Cers4", "De novo synthesis",
  "Cers5",  "De novo synthesis", "Cers6", "De novo synthesis",
  "Degs1",  "De novo synthesis", "Degs2", "De novo synthesis",
  "Sgms1",  "SM conversion", "Sgms2", "SM conversion",
  "Ugcg",   "SM conversion",
  "Smpd1",  "SM conversion", "Smpd2", "SM conversion",
  "Smpd3",  "SM conversion",
  "Asah1",  "Salvage pathway", "Asah2", "Salvage pathway",
  "Acer1",  "Salvage pathway", "Acer2", "Salvage pathway",
  "Acer3",  "Salvage pathway",
  "Gba",    "Salvage pathway", "Gba2",  "Salvage pathway",
  "Sphk1",  "S1P axis", "Sphk2", "S1P axis", "Sgpl1", "S1P axis"
)

# Look up gene expression at both timepoints
sl_panel <- sl_genes |>
  left_join(tx_9m  |> transmute(gene_name, log2fc_9m = log2fc,
                                pval_9m = p_value, fdr_9m = fdr),
            by = "gene_name") |>
  left_join(tx_15m |> transmute(gene_name, log2fc_15m = log2fc,
                                pval_15m = p_value, fdr_15m = fdr),
            by = "gene_name")

# Reshape for heatmap
sl_heatmap <- sl_panel |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(log2fc_9m, log2fc_15m),
               names_to = "tp_var", values_to = "log2fc") |>
  mutate(
    timepoint = if_else(tp_var == "log2fc_9m", "9 Months", "15 Months"),
    fdr  = if_else(tp_var == "log2fc_9m", fdr_9m, fdr_15m),
    pval = if_else(tp_var == "log2fc_9m", pval_9m, pval_15m),
    sig_label = case_when(
      fdr < 0.01  ~ "**",
      fdr < 0.05  ~ "*",
      pval < 0.05 ~ "\u2020",
      TRUE        ~ ""
    ),
    gene_name = factor(gene_name, levels = rev(sl_genes$gene_name))
  )

vmax_sl <- max(abs(sl_heatmap$log2fc), na.rm = TRUE)

p_sl_gene_panel <- ggplot(sl_heatmap, aes(x = timepoint, y = gene_name, fill = log2fc)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = POST_LABEL_SIZE, color = "black") +
  facet_grid(arm ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-vmax_sl, vmax_sl),
                       name = expression(log[2] ~ "FC"),
                       na.value = "grey90") +
  labs(title = "Sphingolipid Pathway Gene Expression",
       subtitle = "** FDR < 0.01, * FDR < 0.05, \u2020 p < 0.05",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_post() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", size = 14),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"))
p_sl_gene_panel
```

## Lysosomal Dysfunction Module

The manuscript describes a decline in lysosomal biogenesis, especially
cathepsins. We visualise the full lysosomal gene cluster and the
XIAP–CathepsinB–SMPD1 anti-apoptosis axis.

### Cathepsin & Lysosomal Gene Panel

```{r}
#| label: fig-lysosomal-panel
#| echo: true
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

# Cathepsin and lysosomal gene panel
lyso_genes <- tribble(
  ~gene_name, ~category,
  "Ctsa", "Cathepsin", "Ctsb", "Cathepsin", "Ctsc", "Cathepsin",
  "Ctsd", "Cathepsin", "Ctse", "Cathepsin", "Ctsh", "Cathepsin",
  "Ctsk", "Cathepsin", "Ctsl", "Cathepsin", "Ctso", "Cathepsin",
  "Ctss", "Cathepsin", "Ctsw", "Cathepsin", "Ctsz", "Cathepsin",
  "Ctsf", "Cathepsin",
  "Lamp1",  "Membrane & transport", "Lamp2",   "Membrane & transport",
  "Lamtor1","Membrane & transport", "Lamtor2", "Membrane & transport",
  "Lamtor3","Membrane & transport", "Laptm5",  "Membrane & transport",
  "Hexb",   "Hydrolase", "Hexdc",  "Hydrolase",
  "Glb1",   "Hydrolase", "Idua",   "Hydrolase",
  "Gusb",   "Hydrolase", "Fuca1",  "Hydrolase",
  "Tpp1",   "Hydrolase", "Man2b1", "Hydrolase",
  "Pla2g15","Hydrolase",
  "Glmp",   "Other lysosomal", "Mfsd1",  "Other lysosomal",
  "Slc15a4","Other lysosomal", "Slc36a1","Other lysosomal",
  "Stard3", "Other lysosomal", "Engase", "Other lysosomal",
  "Xiap",   "Anti-apoptosis"
)

# Look up expression
lyso_panel <- lyso_genes |>
  left_join(tx_9m  |> transmute(gene_name, log2fc_9m = log2fc,
                                pval_9m = p_value, fdr_9m = fdr),
            by = "gene_name") |>
  left_join(tx_15m |> transmute(gene_name, log2fc_15m = log2fc,
                                pval_15m = p_value, fdr_15m = fdr),
            by = "gene_name")

# Reshape for heatmap
lyso_heatmap <- lyso_panel |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(log2fc_9m, log2fc_15m),
               names_to = "tp_var", values_to = "log2fc") |>
  mutate(
    timepoint = if_else(tp_var == "log2fc_9m", "9 Months", "15 Months"),
    fdr  = if_else(tp_var == "log2fc_9m", fdr_9m, fdr_15m),
    pval = if_else(tp_var == "log2fc_9m", pval_9m, pval_15m),
    sig_label = case_when(fdr < 0.01 ~ "**", fdr < 0.05 ~ "*",
                          pval < 0.05 ~ "\u2020", TRUE ~ ""),
    gene_name = factor(gene_name, levels = rev(lyso_genes$gene_name))
  )

vmax_lyso <- max(abs(lyso_heatmap$log2fc), na.rm = TRUE)

p_lyso_panel <- ggplot(lyso_heatmap, aes(x = timepoint, y = gene_name, fill = log2fc)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = POST_LABEL_SIZE, color = "black") +
  facet_grid(category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-vmax_lyso, vmax_lyso),
                       name = expression(log[2] ~ "FC"),
                       na.value = "grey90") +
  labs(title = "Lysosomal Gene Expression Panel",
       subtitle = "** FDR < 0.01, * FDR < 0.05, \u2020 p < 0.05",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_post() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", size = 14),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"))
p_lyso_panel
```

### Anti-Apoptosis Axis: XIAP–CathepsinB–SMPD1

The manuscript proposes that downregulated acid sphingomyelinase (SMPD1) reduces
lysosomal ceramide generation, which decreases CathepsinB release to the cytosol,
preserving XIAP and blocking apoptosis.

```{r}
#| label: fig-xiap-axis
#| echo: true
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.5

# XIAP-CtsB-Smpd1 axis: focused trajectory panel
axis_genes <- c("Xiap", "Ctsb", "Smpd1")

axis_data <- tibble(gene_name = axis_genes) |>
  left_join(tx_9m  |> transmute(gene_name, log2fc_9m = log2fc, fdr_9m = fdr),
            by = "gene_name") |>
  left_join(tx_15m |> transmute(gene_name, log2fc_15m = log2fc, fdr_15m = fdr),
            by = "gene_name") |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(log2fc_9m, log2fc_15m),
               names_to = "tp_var", values_to = "log2fc") |>
  mutate(
    timepoint = if_else(tp_var == "log2fc_9m", "9 Months", "15 Months"),
    fdr = if_else(tp_var == "log2fc_9m", fdr_9m, fdr_15m),
    sig = fdr < 0.05,
    gene_name = factor(gene_name, levels = axis_genes)
  )

p_xiap_axis <- ggplot(axis_data, aes(x = timepoint, y = log2fc, fill = log2fc > 0)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f%s", log2fc, if_else(sig, "*", ""))),
            vjust = if_else(axis_data$log2fc > 0, -0.3, 1.3), size = POST_LABEL_SIZE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey50") +
  facet_wrap(~ gene_name, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#d95f02", `FALSE` = "#1b9e77"),
                    guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Anti-Apoptosis Axis: XIAP\u2013CathepsinB\u2013SMPD1",
       subtitle = "Rps2-A226Y Mutant vs WT, Liver (* FDR < 0.05)",
       y = expression(log[2] ~ "FC"), x = NULL) +
  theme_post() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold.italic", size = 14),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
p_xiap_axis
```

## Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA)

Pre-ranked GSEA uses the full transcriptome ranking (not just significant genes),
testing whether curated gene sets are enriched at the extremes of the ranked list.
We use fgsea with MSigDB Hallmark and KEGG gene sets for mouse.

```{r}
#| label: gsea-preranked
#| echo: true

# Prepare ranked gene lists: stat = sign(log2FC) * -log10(p)
make_rank <- function(tx_data) {
  stats <- tx_data |>
    filter(!is.na(gene_name), !is.na(p_value)) |>
    mutate(rank_stat = sign(log2fc) * -log10(pmax(p_value, 1e-10))) |>
    distinct(gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE)
  rank_vec <- stats$rank_stat
  names(rank_vec) <- stats$gene_name
  sort(rank_vec, decreasing = TRUE)
}

ranks_9m  <- make_rank(tx_9m)
ranks_15m <- make_rank(tx_15m)

# Load mouse gene sets from MSigDB (Hallmark + KEGG)
hallmark_df <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", collection = "H")
hallmark_sets <- split(hallmark_df$gene_symbol, hallmark_df$gs_name)
kegg_df <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", collection = "C2",
                   subcollection = "CP:KEGG_MEDICUS")
kegg_sets <- split(kegg_df$gene_symbol, kegg_df$gs_name)

gene_sets <- c(hallmark_sets, kegg_sets)
cat("Gene sets loaded:", length(hallmark_sets), "Hallmark +",
    length(kegg_sets), "KEGG =", length(gene_sets), "total\n")

# Run fgsea
set.seed(8471)
gsea_9m  <- fgsea(pathways = gene_sets, stats = ranks_9m,
                  minSize = 10, maxSize = 500) |> as_tibble()
gsea_15m <- fgsea(pathways = gene_sets, stats = ranks_15m,
                  minSize = 10, maxSize = 500) |> as_tibble()

cat("Significant (padj < 0.05) — 9m:", sum(gsea_9m$padj < 0.05),
    "| 15m:", sum(gsea_15m$padj < 0.05), "\n")
```

### GSEA Results Comparison

```{r}
#| label: fig-gsea-comparison
#| echo: true
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 8

# Merge GSEA results across timepoints
gsea_merged <- gsea_9m |>
  dplyr::select(pathway, NES_9m = NES, padj_9m = padj, size_9m = size) |>
  full_join(
    gsea_15m |>
      dplyr::select(pathway, NES_15m = NES, padj_15m = padj, size_15m = size),
    by = "pathway"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    sig_cat = case_when(
      padj_9m < 0.05 & padj_15m < 0.05 ~ "Both",
      padj_9m < 0.05  ~ "9m only",
      padj_15m < 0.05 ~ "15m only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    pathway_clean = pathway |>
      str_remove("^HALLMARK_") |>
      str_remove("^KEGG_MEDICUS_") |>
      str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
      str_to_title()
  )

sig_cols <- c(Both = "#e7298a", `9m only` = "#66a61e",
              `15m only` = "#7570b3", Neither = "#cccccc")

# Panel A: NES scatter (9m vs 15m)
p_nes <- gsea_merged |>
  mutate(sig_cat = factor(sig_cat,
         levels = c("Neither", "9m only", "15m only", "Both"))) |>
  arrange(sig_cat) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = NES_9m, y = NES_15m, color = sig_cat)) +
  geom_point(aes(alpha = sig_cat, size = sig_cat)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = \(d) d |> filter(sig_cat %in% c("Both", "9m only", "15m only")) |>
      slice_max(abs(NES_15m) + abs(NES_9m), n = 15),
    aes(label = pathway_clean), size = POST_LABEL_SIZE, max.overlaps = 15,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sig_cols, name = "Significant at") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(Neither = 0.1, `9m only` = 0.8,
                                `15m only` = 0.8, Both = 0.9), guide = "none") +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(Neither = 0.5, `9m only` = 2,
                               `15m only` = 2, Both = 2.5), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "NES: 9m vs 15m",
       x = "NES at 9 Months", y = "NES at 15 Months") +
  theme_post() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom")

# Panel B: Top terms dot plot at 15m
top_terms <- gsea_15m |>
  filter(padj < 0.1) |>
  arrange(padj) |>
  head(20) |>
  mutate(
    pathway_clean = pathway |>
      str_remove("^HALLMARK_") |>
      str_remove("^KEGG_MEDICUS_") |>
      str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
      str_to_title(),
    pathway_clean = fct_reorder(pathway_clean, NES)
  )

p_top <- ggplot(top_terms,
       aes(x = NES, y = pathway_clean, size = size, color = padj)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#b2182b", high = "#fddbc7", name = "Adj. p") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8), name = "Gene set size") +
  labs(title = "Top GSEA Terms at 15 Months",
       x = "Normalized Enrichment Score", y = NULL) +
  theme_post() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

p_gsea_comparison <- p_nes + p_top +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Gene Set Enrichment Analysis: fgsea + MSigDB",
    subtitle = "Rps2-A226Y Mutant vs WT, Liver",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16))
  )
p_gsea_comparison
```

## Cross-Omics Pathway Concordance

For each curated pathway, we test whether gene and metabolite changes agree in
direction. A positive concordance score means both layers shift the same way;
negative means they diverge.

```{r}
#| label: fig-concordance
#| echo: true
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

# Within-pathway concordance: gene vs metabolite direction agreement
compute_concordance <- function(tx_data, met_data, pw_map) {
  map_dfr(names(pw_map), function(pw_name) {
    pw <- pw_map[[pw_name]]

    gene_fc <- tx_data |>
      filter(tolower(gene_name) %in% tolower(pw$genes), significant) |>
      pull(log2fc)
    met_fc <- met_data |>
      filter(sub_pathway %in% pw$met_subpathways, significant) |>
      pull(log2fc)

    tibble(
      pathway      = pw_name,
      mean_gene_fc = if (length(gene_fc) > 0) mean(gene_fc) else NA_real_,
      mean_met_fc  = if (length(met_fc) > 0)  mean(met_fc)  else NA_real_,
      n_genes_sig  = length(gene_fc),
      n_met_sig    = length(met_fc),
      concordant   = !is.na(mean(gene_fc)) & !is.na(mean(met_fc)) &
                     sign(mean(gene_fc)) == sign(mean(met_fc))
    )
  })
}

conc_9m  <- compute_concordance(tx_9m, met_9m, pathway_map) |>
  mutate(timepoint = "9 Months")
conc_15m <- compute_concordance(tx_15m, met_15m, pathway_map) |>
  mutate(timepoint = "15 Months")

conc_data <- bind_rows(conc_9m, conc_15m) |>
  mutate(
    concordance_score = case_when(
      is.na(mean_gene_fc) | is.na(mean_met_fc) ~ NA_real_,
      concordant ~ sqrt(abs(mean_gene_fc) * abs(mean_met_fc)) *
                   sign(mean_gene_fc),
      TRUE ~ -sqrt(abs(mean_gene_fc) * abs(mean_met_fc))
    ),
    label = case_when(
      is.na(concordance_score) ~ "No data",
      concordant ~ "Agree",
      TRUE ~ "Disagree"
    ),
    pathway = fct_rev(fct_inorder(pathway))
  )

p_concordance <- ggplot(conc_data, aes(x = timepoint, y = pathway, fill = concordance_score)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%s\nG:%d M:%d",
                                label, n_genes_sig, n_met_sig)),
            size = POST_LABEL_SIZE) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b",
                       midpoint = 0, name = "Concordance\nscore",
                       na.value = "grey90") +
  labs(title = "Cross-Omics Pathway Concordance",
       subtitle = "Gene vs metabolite direction agreement (significant features)",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_post() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), panel.grid = element_blank())
p_concordance
```
